template: Create an image: 16:9 landscape wallpaper, highest resolution available. Purpose: background of a 4K OLED boot-manager screen. STRICT LAYOUT: pure black #000000 fills at least 80% of the frame. The whole center, the top-left area and the bottom strip must be completely empty pure black (UI cards and text are drawn there). Artwork ONLY in two places: a large piece in the top-right corner (at most the right 30% of the width and the top 45% of the height) and a smaller piece in the bottom-left corner (at most the left 25% of the width and the bottom 35% of the height). Both pieces dissolve into pure black with ragged ink edges. Style: dark anime / manga ink illustration, white and grey linework with heavy hatching, subtle glitch scanlines, ONE glowing accent color: {accent}. Theme: {theme}. Top-right: {top_right}. Bottom-left: {bottom_left}. Original characters only. Absolutely no text, letters, runes, logos, watermarks, frames or UI elements; no fruit or food.
